proof.title: Your regulars are worth more than you think
proof.lead: Three numbers worth knowing before you decide anything. Each one links to where it came from.

stats.claim: Regulars generate about six times more annual revenue than one-time customers.
stats.context: Square defined a regular as someone who visits at least four times a year, then analysed seven years of transactions across small businesses like yours.
stats.source: Square Local Economy Report, March 2026 (US data)

stats.claim: Winning a new customer costs five to twenty-five times more than keeping one you already have.
stats.context: The gap between an ad that buys one visit and a card that earns the next ten.

stats.claim: Fifty-eight percent of people are less likely to join a loyalty program that makes them download an app.
stats.context: 79% said they're more likely to join one with no physical card to carry. A wallet pass is neither.

calculator.title: How many regulars does PunchMe need to pay for itself?
calculator.lead: Fewer than you would think. Move the sliders to match your shop — nothing you type here leaves your browser.

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't

items.title: A designer with a live preview
items.body: Logo, colors, stamp count and reward — the card changes as you type.

items.title: Apple Wallet and Google Wallet
items.body: One pass, both platforms. It sits beside their boarding passes and bank cards.

items.title: Nothing for customers to install
items.body: No app, no account, no password. One QR scan and the card is saved.

items.title: Stamps by scanning the pass
items.body: Scan the QR on your customer's card and the stamp lands straight away.

items.title: Rewards that track themselves
items.body: The card counts up on its own and unlocks the reward the moment it's earned.

items.title: See who's coming back
items.body: A dashboard of your customers, their progress, and every visit as it happens.

items.q: Does my customer need to download an app?
items.a: No. The card is a wallet pass, so it opens straight into the Apple Wallet or Google Wallet already on their phone. They scan your QR code once and it's saved — nothing to install, no account to create, no password to forget.

items.q: How do I add a stamp?
items.a: You scan the QR code on the customer's pass. It takes about as long as handing back a receipt, and the stamp appears on their card straight away.

items.q: What happens if they change phones?
items.a: Their stamps are stored against their card on our side, not on the phone itself, so the count is never lost. Moving the pass onto a new handset isn't automatic yet — message us and we'll sort it out.

items.q: What does it cost, and when am I charged?
items.a: Designing your card, previewing it on your own phone and using the dashboard are free for as long as you like. You're charged ₪59 a month only when you activate the card for real customers.

items.q: Can I change the design after I launch?
items.a: Yes. Colors, stamp count and reward can all be changed after you go live — message us with what you want changed and we'll apply it to your card.

items.q: Does it work on both iPhone and Android?
items.a: Yes. iPhone customers get an Apple Wallet pass and Android customers get a Google Wallet pass. Both update the same way, and you scan them the same way.

items.title: Customers keep coming back
items.body: The card lives in the wallet that's already on every phone — no app to install means no friction to earning your next visit.

items.title: No more lost sales from lost cards
items.body: Paper cards get torn, forgotten at home, or tossed. A digital card can't be left behind — every visit still counts.

items.title: Try it with zero risk
items.body: Design and preview exactly how your card will look, for free. You only pay once it's actually bringing customers back.
